notes.warning_1_edge_ceiling: REAL RENDERING-FIDELITY GAP. [GlassEdges] reports edge count 153,957 exceeds the 65,536 ceiling, so 88,421 edges (57% of the graph's edges) are NOT rendered. The visual is therefore a partial view of the topology. Fix is rendering.maxEdgesCeiling, per the warning's own advice — worth a deliberate decision rather than leaving it silent, since nothing in the UI tells the viewer that most edges are missing.
notes.warning_2_403s: Three requests 403 'Authentication required': GET /api/broker/inbox (x2) and POST /api/layout/mode. These surface as red console errors on every load. The broker inbox and the layout-mode control are auth-gated but the client calls them unauthenticated on boot, so this is either a missing session/credential in the dev client or calls that should be gated client-side until authenticated. Cosmetically it means the dev client never loads with a clean console; functionally the layout-mode POST being refused may be why the layout control cannot be driven.
notes.warning_3_layout_shape: OBSERVATION, not a confirmed defect. With Layout: Force Directed, the 13,165 nodes render as a dense rectangular slab with edges radiating outward, rather than a spread force-directed cloud. The scene IS animating (frames differ), so this is not a frozen render. Possible causes: physics not converged, initial positions still bounded, or the refused POST /api/layout/mode preventing the layout from being applied. Worth an eyeball from whoever owns the layout path — see shots/visionclaw.png.
notes.warning_4_voice: Informational only: 'Voice features unavailable: Secure connection (HTTPS) required' — expected when reaching the dev client over plain http, not a fault.
notes.polling_behaviour: The client polls /api/bots/data and /api/bots/status very frequently (roughly 20 requests in the first few seconds, still pending at capture). Combined with the live websocket this is worth a look for redundant traffic, but all such requests return 200.
